verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say it supports over 20 public or private package types, explicitly naming npm, PyPI, Maven and Container images. A community user independently confirms the 1.17 package registry replaced their Verdaccio npm registry. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of publish/consume workflows (auth, client configuration, visibility controls per format), hands-on corroboration for formats beyond npm.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish and consume public or private packages and container images in many formats such as npm, PyPI, and Maven

citations.quote: Gitea supports over 20 different types of public or private software package management, including Cargo, Chef, Composer, Conan, Conda, Container, Helm, Maven, npm, NuGet, Pub, PyPI, RubyGems, Vagrant, and more.
Another user says the 1.17 package registry lets them ditch Verdaccio.
